Q:4:5:o1: Lift it slowly and see what happens
Q:4:5:o3: Lift it on the strongest forklift available
Q:4:5:o4: Don't lift it until you've confirmed the weight
Q:4:6:p: Fitting an attachment to a forklift will usually:
Q:4:6:e: Attachments add weight and move the load centre forward, so capacity goes down.
Q:4:7:p: Which is the ONLY acceptable way to lift a person with a forklift?
Q:4:7:e: Only a purpose-built work platform designed for the forklift, secured to it, with the operator at the controls.
Q:4:7:o3: In a purpose-built work platform secured to the forklift
Q:4:8:p: Which is an example of a dynamic load?
Q:4:8:e: Liquid in a drum or IBC moves while you travel, shifting the centre of gravity.
Q:4:9:p: A load is heavier on one side. Before lifting, you should:
Q:4:9:e: Position the tynes (or use side shift) so the load is centred, or have it restacked.
Q:4:9:o1: Lift it high to balance it
Q:4:9:o2: Drive faster so it doesn't tip
Q:4:9:o3: Centre the load on the tynes or have it restacked
Q:5:1:p: A pallet holds 5 layers of 10 cartons. Each carton weighs 20 kg and the pallet weighs 30 kg. What is the total weight?
Q:5:2:p: A consignment note shows a load of 1.5 t. How many kilograms is that?
Q:5:3:p: One pallet (50 kg) carries three items: 400 kg, 350 kg and 600 kg. What is the total weight?
Q:5:3:e: 400 + 350 + 600 = 1,350 kg. Add the 50 kg pallet = 1,400 kg.
Q:5:4:p: A weighbridge docket shows the loaded truck at 18,000 kg and the empty truck at 12,000 kg. The load is 4 identical pallets. How much does each pallet weigh?
Q:5:5:p: You may lift a maximum of 1,000 kg. The pallet weighs 40 kg and each carton weighs 30 kg. What is the most cartons you can load?
Q:5:6:p: You may lift a maximum of 1,000 kg. The pallet weighs 20 kg and each carton weighs 30 kg. What is the most cartons you can load?
Q:5:6:e: 1,000 − 20 = 980. 980 ÷ 30 = 32.67 — always round DOWN: 32. 33 cartons would weigh 1,010 kg with the pallet.
Q:5:7:p: An evenly loaded crate is 1,200 mm deep and sits hard against the backrest. What is its load centre?
Q:5:8:p: An evenly loaded crate 1,000 mm deep is sitting 200 mm away from the backrest. What is its load centre?
Q:5:9:p: Forklift A has a rated capacity of 2,500 kg at a 600 mm load centre. Can it lift a 1,900 kg pallet with a 600 mm load centre?
Q:5:9:e: 1,900 kg is less than the 2,500 kg rated capacity, and the load centre is 600 mm — OK to lift, with 600 kg to spare.
Q:5:9:o1: Yes — it's 600 kg under the rated capacity
Q:5:9:o2: No — it's 600 kg over the rated capacity
Q:5:9:o3: No — the load centre is too far out
Q:5:9:o4: Only if someone sits on the back
Q:5:10:p: Forklift A is rated at 2,500 kg. A crate on a consignment note weighs 2.7 t. Can it lift the crate?
Q:5:10:e: 2.7 × 1,000 = 2,700 kg. That's 200 kg more than the 2,500 kg rated capacity — do not lift.
Q:5:10:o1: Yes — 2.7 t is less than 2,500 kg
Q:5:10:o2: No — it's 200 kg over the rated capacity
Q:5:11:p: A forklift is rated at 2,000 kg. A pallet holds 48 cartons of 40 kg each, and the pallet weighs 30 kg. Is the load within the rated capacity?
Q:5:11:e: 48 × 40 = 1,920 kg. 1,920 + 30 = 1,950 kg. That's 50 kg under the 2,000 kg rated capacity — OK to lift.
Q:5:12:p: A forklift is rated at 1,500 kg. Paperwork says the load is 1.8 t. What should you do?
Q:5:12:e: 1.8 × 1,000 = 1,800 kg — 300 kg over the 1,500 kg rated capacity. Don't lift it; tell your supervisor.
Q:5:12:o2: Lift it with the load tilted back
Q:5:12:o3: Don't lift it — it's 300 kg over the rated capacity
Q:5:12:o4: Lift it if the ground is flat
Q:5:13:p: A forklift with a drum carrier is rated at 2,500 kg. Each full drum weighs 600 kg. What is the most drums it can carry at once?
Q:5:13:e: 2,500 ÷ 600 = 4.17 — always round down: 4 drums (2,400 kg). Five drums would be 3,000 kg.
Q:5:14:p: A forklift is rated at 2,500 kg. It is carrying a 1,800 kg crate. How much more weight could be added without going over the rated capacity?
Q:6:1:p: You are carrying a load up a ramp. How should you travel?
Q:6:1:e: Loaded, keep the load uphill: forwards up, reverse down.
Q:6:1:o1: Drive forwards up the ramp, load uphill
Q:6:1:o2: Reverse up the ramp, load downhill
Q:6:1:o4: Raise the load high for better visibility
Q:6:2:p: The load is blocking your forward view. What should you do?
Q:6:2:e: Travel in reverse, looking in the direction of travel, or use an observer.
Q:6:2:o2: Travel in reverse or use an observer
Q:6:2:o3: Lean out the side and drive forwards
Q:6:2:o4: Sound the horn continuously and drive forwards
Q:6:3:p: What is the purpose of a trial lift?
Q:6:3:e: Lifting just clear of the support lets you confirm the forklift is stable and the load is secure before moving.
Q:6:3:o3: To check the forklift is stable and the load is secure before moving
Q:6:3:o4: To measure the height of the rack
Q:6:4:p: When may you raise or lower a load?
Q:6:4:e: Only when the forklift is stationary.
Q:6:4:o3: Only when the forklift is stationary
Q:6:4:o4: Any time if the area is clear
Q:6:5:p: A crate has no pallet. How can you lift it without damaging it?
Q:6:5:e: Place it on gluts or dunnage so the tynes can be inserted and withdrawn.
Q:6:5:o3: Lift it with a chain around the mast
Q:6:5:o4: Place it on gluts or dunnage
Q:6:6:p: A co-worker asks for a lift across the warehouse on the forklift. You should:
Q:6:6:o1: Let them stand on the tynes
Q:6:6:o2: Let them sit on the counterweight
Q:6:6:o3: Drive slowly with them on board
Q:6:6:o4: Refuse — forklifts must never carry passengers
Q:6:7:p: Before loading a truck at a dock, you must make sure:
Q:6:7:e: The truck must be secured so it can't move, and the dock plate must be secure and rated.
Q:6:7:o2: The truck is secured from moving and the dock plate is secure and rated
Q:6:7:o3: The truck driver stays in the cab
Q:7:1:p: When parking a forklift, the tynes should be:
Q:7:1:e: Lower them fully to the ground with the tips resting on the floor.
Q:7:2:p: Which gas is released when charging a lead-acid forklift battery?
Q:7:2:e: Charging releases hydrogen, which is explosive — ventilation is essential.
Q:7:3:p: How should you check a newly fitted LPG cylinder for leaks?
Q:7:3:e: Use soapy water or a leak-detection solution. Never a flame.
Q:7:3:o3: With soapy water or leak-detection solution
Q:7:3:o4: By running the engine at full revs
Q:7:4:p: What PPE should you wear when changing an LPG cylinder?
Q:7:4:e: Gloves and eye protection — LPG can cause cold burns.
Q:7:5:p: Where should you NOT park a forklift?
Q:7:5:e: Never block exits, walkways, fire equipment or switchboards, and never park on a slope.
Q:7:5:o4: In front of a fire extinguisher
Q:final:1:p: Who issues a High Risk Work Licence?
Q:final:1:e: The state or territory WHS regulator issues the licence after an accredited assessor assesses you.
